# Atlantis NDT

> Founder-led non-destructive testing (NDT) company: inspection services, ASNT SNT-TC-1A training, outsourced ASNT Level III consulting, and inspection software (Atlantis ERP, NDT reporting, digital twin reporting, Practical NDT simulator). Offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India; work is delivered remotely, online, or on-site at the client's facility.

Founder: Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, with 11+ years of international NDT field experience. NAS 410 Level 3 services are provided through an associate who holds NAS 410 Level 3.

## Services
- [NDT Training](https://atlantisndt.com/training): ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I and II courses (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, PAUT, TOFD) and Level III exam preparation. Theory is self-paced and runs year-round; practicals are done in the Practical NDT simulator and in person at the employer's facility. A course does not certify anyone: under SNT-TC-1A the employer certifies.
- [ASNT Level III Consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-consulting-level-iii): outsourced Level III, written practices, procedures, examinations and audit support.
- [NDT Written Practice Development](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-written-practice-development): SNT-TC-1A written practices, with a free template.
- [Inspection Services](https://atlantisndt.com/inspection-services): UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and VT field inspection with Level III-reviewed reports; API 510, 570 and 653 programme support.
- [3D Scanning Services](https://atlantisndt.com/3d-scanning-services): LiDAR, photogrammetry and drone capture for as-built models (a scan records surfaces, not wall thickness).

## Software
- [Atlantis ERP](https://atlantisndt.com/erp): business management for inspection companies: technician certifications, equipment calibration, jobs, quoting, invoicing and NDT reports. [Free trial](https://atlantisndt.com/free-trial).
- [NDT Inspection Software](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-inspection-software): buyer's guide and product overview.
- [Best NDT Reporting Software](https://atlantisndt.com/best-ndt-reporting-software-2026): comparison of NDT reporting platforms.
- [Digital Twin Reporting](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twin-reporting): inspection history on a navigable 3D asset model, with a labelled sample report.
- [Practical NDT](https://atlantisndt.com/practical-ndt): browser-based 3D practical simulator (12 method families, 12 workplaces, 33 lessons, 473 jobs), integrated with the Atlantis LMS and ERP.

## Free tools and practice
- [NDT Practice Tests](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-practice-tests): Level II practice questions for UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET.
- [Ultrasonic A-scan Simulator](https://atlantisndt.com/tools/ultrasonic-a-scan-simulator)
